entry.title: New: Resolution 73 (2024-2026) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
APPROVES THE NOMINATION OF MEMBERS TO THE NATIONAL ASSOCIATION OF COUNTIES (NACo) BOARD OF DIRECTORS AND THE WESTERN INTERSTATE REGION (WIR) BOARD OF DIRECTORS

Requests the Council’s approval of the following slates of officers: NACo – KipuKai Kualiʻi, Kauaʻi County, and Tommy Waters, City and County of Honolulu
